title: Ancient Ruins
subtitle: Unreal Engine 5 Environment
description: A cinematic ruins environment built in Unreal Engine 5 featuring ancient stone structures, overgrown vegetation, volumetric lighting and atmospheric post-processing.
contribution: Full environment creation — asset placement, modular architecture composition, lighting setup, atmospheric fog, and camera framing.

assetBreakdown.heading: Built From Individual Assets.
assetBreakdown.description: A closer look at the 3D assets and props I created and integrated into this environment.

assets.name: Ruined Stone Pillar
assets.description: A weathered stone pillar with chipped edges and aged surface detail, used throughout the ruins as a structural element.

assets.name: Crumbled Wall Section
assets.description: Modular crumbled wall piece designed to tile seamlessly, allowing flexible layout of ruined structures.

assets.name: Overgrown Stone Block
assets.description: Fallen stone block with moss and vegetation growth, adding organic detail and a sense of age to the scene.

assets.name: Archway Fragment
assets.description: A broken archway segment that hints at the original structure's scale and architectural style.

assets.name: Scattered Rubble
assets.description: A collection of loose stone debris pieces used to dress the ground and add visual weight around larger structures.

assets.name: Stone Step Block
assets.description: Weathered stepped platform block used to build tiered levels and elevation changes within the ruins.

assets.name: Decorative Carved Stone
assets.description: Ornamental stone piece with carved surface patterns, placed as a detail element to suggest a once-elaborate civilisation.

title: Shattered Peaks
subtitle: Unreal Engine 5 Environment
description: A dramatic mountain and rocky terrain environment built in Unreal Engine 5. The scene features large-scale landscape sculpting, natural rock formations, dynamic sky, and cinematic lighting.
contribution: Full environment — terrain sculpting, rock placement, foliage, sky and lighting setup, scene composition and cinematic framing.

title: Lake Landscape
subtitle: Unreal Engine 5 Environment
description: A real-time lake environment built in Unreal Engine 5. The scene features a natural lakeside landscape with foliage, water, atmospheric lighting, and scene composition created entirely by me.
contribution: All environment work — landscape sculpting, foliage placement, water system setup, lighting, sky atmosphere, and scene composition.

title: Scrap Wars
subtitle: Demolition Derby Survival
description: Vehicle combat survival game featuring AI opponents, a dynamic vehicle damage system, and deep gameplay systems including Racing and Demolition Derby modes.
contribution: Sole developer — responsible for all gameplay programming, AI systems, vehicle physics, 3D asset creation in Blender, and scene assembly in Unity.

breakdown.label: AI Systems
breakdown.summary: State-machine-driven enemy AI with dynamic difficulty scaling.
breakdown.details: Built a finite state machine for opponent AI covering idle, chase, attack, and evade states. Implemented difficulty scaling that adjusts opponent aggression and reaction time based on player survival time. Used Unity's NavMesh for pathfinding within the arena.

breakdown.label: Vehicle Damage System
breakdown.summary: Procedural mesh deformation tied to physics collision force.
breakdown.details: Designed a modular damage system where each vehicle section has its own health pool. Collisions above a force threshold trigger mesh deformation using vertex displacement. Visual damage states (dents, sparks, smoke particles) layer progressively as health decreases.

breakdown.label: Physics & Handling
breakdown.summary: Custom WheelCollider tuning for arcade-feel vehicle physics.
breakdown.details: Extended Unity's WheelCollider system with custom friction curves to achieve a fun, arcade-style handling model. Added drift mechanics via lateral force blending and implemented a rigidbody centre-of-mass adjustment for consistent flip resistance.

breakdown.label: Performance Optimization
breakdown.summary: Maintained 60fps on mid-range hardware through targeted profiling.
breakdown.details: Used Unity Profiler to identify draw call bottlenecks. Implemented static batching for arena geometry, GPU instancing for particle debris, and LOD groups on vehicle meshes.

title: Hell Drive
subtitle: Level-Based Driving Game
description: Level-based driving game built in Unity. Drive through obstacle-filled environments, collect coins, and minimize vehicle damage to complete each level.
contribution: Sole developer — gameplay programming, level design, vehicle physics, collectible systems, and UI implementation.

breakdown.label: Level Design
breakdown.summary: Iterative blockout-to-final pipeline with focus on flow and pacing.
breakdown.details: Started each level with a grey-box blockout to validate driving flow and checkpoint spacing. Used playtesting data to iteratively widen corners, adjust ramp angles, and redistribute collectibles.

breakdown.label: Collectible System
breakdown.summary: Data-driven collectible spawner with persistent save state.
breakdown.details: Built a ScriptableObject-based collectible system. Collected state is persisted via PlayerPrefs with a serialised bitfield for efficient storage.

breakdown.label: Progression Design
breakdown.summary: Unlockable levels and vehicles gated by score thresholds.
breakdown.details: Designed a meta-progression loop where star ratings (1–3 per level) unlock new vehicles and level packs.

breakdown.label: UI & Feedback
breakdown.summary: Responsive HUD with animated score feedback.
breakdown.details: Built the in-game HUD using Unity UI Toolkit for resolution independence. Implemented animated score popups using DOTween.

title: Airborne Bling
subtitle: 3D Flight Adventure
description: Browser-based 3D flight game built with React Three Fiber featuring aircraft controls, collectible targets, collision detection, and dynamic environments.
contribution: Sole developer — flight controller, collision systems, environment rendering, game UI, and deployment.

breakdown.label: Flight System
breakdown.summary: Custom aircraft movement and camera-follow mechanics.
breakdown.details: Developed a custom flight controller using local axis transformations for pitch, roll, yaw, and forward movement. Smooth quaternion interpolation for realistic aircraft rotation.

breakdown.label: Gameplay Systems
breakdown.summary: Collectible targets, scoring, and progression mechanics.
breakdown.details: Designed collectible coin targets throughout the environment with collision detection, score tracking, and target respawning.

breakdown.label: Collision & Boundaries
breakdown.summary: Terrain collision detection and restricted-area management.
breakdown.details: Built a raycast-based terrain collision system with boundary detection, warning states, and game-over conditions.

breakdown.label: Environment & Rendering
breakdown.details: Integrated GLTF environment assets, HDR lighting, reflective water surfaces, skybox rendering, and post-processing effects.

title: Clash of Champions
subtitle: 2D Fighting Game
description: A 2D fighting game featuring fast-paced one-on-one combat, unique character attacks, and round-based gameplay inspired by classic arcade fighters.
contribution: Sole developer — combat system, sprite animation controller, round progression logic, health UI, and sound integration.

breakdown.label: Combat System
breakdown.summary: Responsive fighting mechanics with attacks and health management.
breakdown.details: Implemented movement, jumping, attacking, hit detection, health tracking, and victory conditions.

breakdown.label: Character Animation
breakdown.summary: Sprite-based animation system for all player actions.
breakdown.details: Created an animation controller using sprite sheets for idle, running, jumping, attacking, taking damage, and death states.

breakdown.label: Round System
breakdown.summary: Best-of-three round progression inspired by arcade fighters.
breakdown.details: Designed a round-based match system that tracks victories, resets player states between rounds, and determines the final winner.

breakdown.label: UI & Feedback
breakdown.summary: Health bars, round counters, and victory screens.
breakdown.details: Developed a lightweight UI system displaying player health, round wins, and match results.
